subject: https://yusuke-hayashi.com
requirements: The issuer must control the signing key or account named in the proof.
issuer.identifier must equal the EIP-191 address or the openpgp4fpr URI derived from the proof signer.
The statement must be specific, time-bounded where appropriate, and publishable with the issuer's consent.
Active records must not be expired; revoked records must retain a public timestamp and reason.
The attestation must not disclose private contact details, confidential work, wallet balances, or asset-storage addresses.
Publication requires manual review; schema validity alone is not sufficient.
revocation: An issuer may request revocation. Revoked records remain in the index with status=revoked so historical references do not silently disappear.
submission: No automatic submission endpoint is provided. Attestations are accepted only through an explicitly agreed exchange with the issuer.
